name: Purchena (Spain)
description: Light blue field charged at the centre with the municipal arms of Purchena (a crowned shield with a chalice, a lion and a tower, supported by two griffins).
history: Municipal flag of Purchena; Spanish municipal flags are approved by the municipal council and the autonomous community and published in the regional official gazette.

features.role: Purchena arms — chalice, lion and tower, supported by griffins
